name: H Bhuvan Gopal Reddy
text:
We installed 19 uPVC windows and door on the 3rd and 4th floors through V-TECH BUILDING SYSTEMS PRIVATE LIMITED in Ballari.
Product quality is good—finish, alignment, sealing, and sliding smoothness are all satisfactory. Noise reduction is noticeably better, and there were no damages during installation. Pricing felt reasonable, and the installer was polite, punctual, and explained the operation of every window after completion.
One concern: our building has granite frames, and the initial installers were not skilled in using a grinder with diamond cutting bits, which is essential for granite. We had to intervene and guide them, causing temporary work interruption (though no final delay).
Overall: good products and decent service, but installation team skill needs better matching to site conditions.
Recommended—with caution.

text: Don't understand where the 5 star reviews are coming from. The quality of windows and workmanship is extremely poor. Don't go by the assurances of the sales person (who happens to be the owner itself). No proper after sales service as well. AVOID.

name: Kadhambari Keshava
text:
I had a great experience with V-Tech for my UPVC windows installation. Their service was excellent, with timely delivery and a hassle-free process from start to finish. The team was professional and ensured that all issues and queries were promptly addressed without any delays.

I truly appreciate their commitment to quality and customer satisfaction. Based on my experience, I would highly recommend V-Tech to anyone looking for reliable and well-crafted UPVC windows.

A special thanks to Syed for his amazing coordination and dedication throughout the project. His professionalism and prompt communication made the entire process smooth and stress-free.
